papers.title_en: Multilayer Q-Matrix-Embedded Neural Network for Cognitive Diagnosis (M-QCDNet): Structure-Aware Deep Learning Architecture for Psychometric Interpretability
papers.evidence: 认知诊断神经网络可测量潜在技能轮廓，适用于批判性思维评估。
papers.tldr: 针对认知诊断中深度学习模型缺乏可解释性、传统CDM灵活性不足的问题，提出M-QCDNet，通过将Q矩阵作为结构先验嵌入多层神经网络，实现技能掌握模式与认知理论的一致性。设计L2惩罚损失函数，平衡预测性能与结构对齐，并提出基于对齐的可解释评估指标。实验表明模型保持高预测精度的同时增强了诊断解释性，为课堂早期学习困难检测和掌握干预提供了公平透明的AI方案，推动认知诊断向可解释、可行动的AI迈进。
papers.abstract_en: The research proposes a multilayer Q-matrix-embedded neural network for cognitive diagnosis (M-QCDNet), which integrates the structural interpretability of cognitive diagnostic models (CDMs) with the deep learning neural network (NN). M-QCDNet structures the item-skill relationship using the Q-matrix as a structural prior, ensuring latent mastery profiles remain interpretable and consistent with cognitive theory, followed by the proposed loss function with an L2 penalty to penalize skills not aligned with the Q-matrix and to balance predictive performance and structural alignment. Corresponding evaluation matrices, the interpretable alignment-based metrics that quantify the degree to which predicted skill activations correspond to item-level skills, were further developed. M-QCDNet offers practical benefits for classroom practice, enabling early detection of learning difficulties and supporting mastery-based interventions. By embedding diagnostic validity into model design, M-QCDNet bridges psychometric transparency and neural flexibility, advancing interpretable, fair, and actionable AI for cognitive diagnostics.
